entry.title: So satisfying: Streak-free cleaning with Bosch GlassVac. 💧

media:group.media:title: So satisfying: Streak-free cleaning with Bosch GlassVac. 💧
media:group.media:description:
When cleaning becomes satisfying to watch. 🤩
The new Bosch GlassVac window vacuum uses patented triple-lip technology for streak-free results on windows, mirrors, and tiles. From shower condensation to spilled liquids, it's ready for more than window cleaning.
Hard-to-reach spots? Its sealed dirty-water tank allows 360° use, even horizontally or overhead, without spilling. Once you're done, simply remove the tank and empty it.
Planning to clean more than a few windows? A single charge lasts up to 35 minutes, enough for around 120 m² or approximately 40 windows.

entry.title: Enough gas for one more BBQ? 🍂🔥 Check with Bosch Filio.

media:group.media:title: Enough gas for one more BBQ? 🍂🔥 Check with Bosch Filio.
media:group.media:description:
The gas grill is ready for one more fall BBQ. Is there enough gas left in the cylinder? 🍂🔥
Simply check with the Bosch Filio gas level detector. Attach it to the gas cylinder: Integrated magnets hold it firmly in place at a precise 90° angle – no holding required! Ultrasound technology then almost instantly detects whether gas is present at the tested height.
Check the light and listen for the acoustic signal: 🟢 = Gas detected 🔴 = No gas detected
Want to check at a different height? Fully remove Filio and reattach it at the new position.
Compact and easy to use, Filio is a handy companion for your next BBQ or camping trip.

entry.title: How does our eBike ABS Pro actually work? #shorts #bosch

media:group.media:title: How does our eBike ABS Pro actually work? #shorts #bosch
media:group.media:description:
⏱️ Decades of engineering, proven in milliseconds. Watch the Bosch eBike ABS Pro engage to turn raw braking power into pure speed! 🚴‍♂️⚡
What started as a safety feature is now the ultimate performance booster. To push the limits, @boschebikesystems tested an eBike ABS Pro prototype on a non-motorized "bio-bike" with Enduro Champion @alexrudeau at the Red Bull Cerro Abajo in Stuttgart.
Bringing this to two wheels meant leveraging 45 years of Bosch ABS pioneering expertise from cars and two-wheelers.
By adjusting braking pressure in milliseconds, the system prevents front-wheel lockups on changing surfaces. For Alex, this means braking much later, maintaining absolute stability, and focusing entirely on his line rather than traction.
Read the full story here: https://bit.ly/BoschCerroAbajo

media:group.media:title: Hidden in the Blind Spot 👀🚛
media:group.media:description:
👀 POV: You look into your side mirror. The road looks completely clear. Right? …Not quite. ⚠️
From the cab of a truck, entire cars, cyclists, and motorcycles can disappear completely into the blind spot. What the human eye can’t see from the driver's seat can turn into a critical situation in a fraction of a second.
That’s where Bosch blind spot detection for commercial vehicles steps in. Radar sensors continuously monitor the adjacent lanes along the entire length of the truck and trailer, extending even behind it. The moment a hidden road user is detected, an alert lights up in the side-view mirror. If the driver indicates to change lanes, the system immediately sounds an acoustic warning — all while smart filtering prevents false alarms from guardrails or parked vehicles.
Watch until the end to see who was actually hiding right next to the truck! 🚛💨

media:group.media:title: Emergency Braking Sounds: Office Edition 🚗🔊
media:group.media:description:
"SCREEECH!" 🚗💨 "BEEP BEEP!" ⚠️ ...or absolute silence? We went around the office and asked our colleagues one simple question: "What does emergency braking sound like?" 🎤 The answers? Let’s just say sound effects aren’t on our job descriptions!
Behind the fun, there’s serious innovation at work. Advanced emergency braking systems (AEBS) do more than warn drivers with acoustic and/or visual signals. They actively calculate braking distance and can initiate full emergency stops automatically to prevent collisions. Installed in heavy commercial vehicles alone, AEBS can help avoid up to 34% of accidents caused by heavy-duty trucks.
Learn more about Bosch advanced emergency braking: https://bit.ly/AutomaticEmergencyBrakingBosch
